subject: general
question: Which of the following is the festival of Kerala that heralds the harvest season, lasts for 10 days, and has snake boat races etc?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Onam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam** is the festival of Kerala that heralds the harvest season.
 
• The festival lasts for **10 days** and is celebrated with various activities such as **snake boat races**, traditional dances, and elaborate feasts.
 
• Onam is celebrated to commemorate the homecoming of the legendary King Mahabali.
 
• It is one of the most significant festivals in Kerala and is marked by a spirit of unity and joy among the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Onam is typically celebrated in the month of **Chingam**, the first month of the Malayalam calendar, which usually falls in **August or September**.
 
• The festival features **Pookalam** (floral decorations), **Onasadya** (a grand feast), and various cultural programs.
 
• Onam is a time when people from all communities come together to celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Kerala.
 
• The traditional attire for Onam includes the **Kasaragod saree** for women and the **Mundu** for men.
 
• Onam is also associated with the famous **Vallam Kali** (snake boat race), which is a major attraction during the festival.
